definitions.explanation: The head of state in a republic, typically elected by the people or parliament.

examples.japanese: アメリカの{大統領|だいとうりょう}が{来日|らいにち}した。
examples.english: The President of the United States visited Japan.

examples.japanese: {大統領選挙|だいとうりょうせんきょ}が{来年|らいねん}{行|おこな}われる。
examples.english: The presidential election will be held next year.

examples.japanese: {大統領|だいとうりょう}が{演説|えんぜつ}をした。

notes:
RELATED TERMS:
- {大統領選挙|だいとうりょうせんきょ} (presidential election)
- {大統領府|だいとうりょうふ} (presidential office/residence)
- {副大統領|ふくだいとうりょう} (vice president)

COMPARISON WITH JAPAN:
- Japan has a {首相|しゅしょう}/{総理大臣|そうりだいじん} (Prime Minister), not a president
- {天皇|てんのう} (Emperor) is the ceremonial head of state

NOTE: {大統領|だいとうりょう} specifically refers to the president of a country. For 'president' of a company, use {社長|しゃちょう}.
